issues.where: frames 2818 to 2974, and again 3286 to 3441 to 3597 to 3909
issues.what: the travel is broken by jumps: the camera leaps from mid-distance to right under the tall animals in under three seconds, then shows a low view along a lava channel on a different heading, then the drinking animal, then a close view of the lava fall; these read as cuts between fixed set-ups, not one move through the place

issues.where: the grey mass at the lower left

issues.where: the upper right of the frame
